TidyCord Pure — Retractable Fast Charging Cable with Data function in Wheat Straw material Dual Input

Short: Eco-friendly retractable charging cable that delivers fast charging and reliable data transfer — dual input for USB-C and Lightning devices.

Product overview

Meet TidyCord Pure charging cable the premium retractable fast  designed for people who want speed, convenience and sustainability. Built from wheat straw composite, delivers fast charging and secure data transfer in a compact, tangle-free retractable design. With dual input connectors (USB-C and Lightning), this retractable supports phones, tablets and accessories with a single cable.

Why choose TidyCord Pure?

  • Fast charging & data: Supports fast charging protocols and reliable data sync—this fast with data keeps pace with modern devices.
  • Dual input convenience: One cable, two connectors—USB-C and Lightning—eliminate the need to carry multiple cables.
  • Eco-friendly material: Wheat straw housing reduces plastic use while remaining durable and lightweight.
  • Retractable & tangle-free: Pull to extend, release to rewind—perfect for travel, commuting, and tidy desks.
  • Durable build: Reinforced contacts and stress-tested retraction mechanism for long-lasting use.

Ideal for

Travelers, remote workers, students, and anyone who values a neat workspace will love this retractable charging cable. Its wheat straw cable body reduces environmental impact while delivering the speed and reliability expected from a modern charging solution.
